caption: The 360 dp row is cut into six equal 60 dp units. Weight 1 takes one unit for Button A (60 dp), weight 2 takes two for B (120 dp), weight 3 takes three for C (180 dp); on a 480 dpi screen these are 180, 360 and 540 px.

spec.title: 360 dp row, six 60 dp units
spec.aria: A 360 dp row split into six 60 dp units: Button A takes one unit (60 dp), Button B two units (120 dp) and Button C three units (180 dp).
